rules:
  - id: legion-command-injection-shell
    languages: [python, javascript, typescript]
    message: Request-controlled data may reach a shell execution sink.
    severity: WARNING
    mode: taint
    pattern-sources:
      - pattern: request.args.get(...)
      - pattern: req.query[...]
    pattern-sinks:
      - pattern: os.system(...)
      - pattern: exec(...)
      - pattern: child_process.exec(...)
  - id: legion-sql-interpolation
    languages: [python, javascript, typescript]
    message: SQL text appears to interpolate variable input.
    severity: WARNING
    mode: taint
    pattern-sources:
      - pattern: request.args.get(...)
    pattern-sinks:
      - pattern: cursor.execute(...)
      - pattern: db.query(...)
